metaDescription: Brussels Griffon vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Brussels Griffon boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Brussels Griffon social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Brussels Griffon exposure.
Weight range 8-10 lb (3.5-4.5 kg) and grooming needs (Wire or smooth coat care; face folds.) belong in the same Brussels Griffon household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Brussels Griffon is also monitored for patellar luxation, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Brussels Griffon appointments.
After the Brussels Griffon puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Brussels Griffon boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Brussels Griffon row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Brussels Griffon item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Brussels Griffon kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Brussels Griffon due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Brussels Griffon core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Brussels Griffon misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Brussels Griffon health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Brussels Griffon adult health guide for breed predispositions such as brachycephalic concerns, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
